newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 4.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
* Polish poet Wislawa Szymborska won the Nobel Prize for Literature.
* U.S. President Bill Clinton and his Republican rival Bob Dole prepare for next Sunday's presidential election debate.
* Conflict between Palestinians and Israelis could erupt if faltering peace process dies out.
